timing: perf_counter_ns; warm OS file cache; no fsync; gc.collect outside timed interval
geometry_precision: 12 decimal place input coordinates; TopoJSON quantization and simplification disabled
common_target: list of id int, class int, and materialized Shapely Polygon objects
hausdorff_method: Discrete GEOS/Shapely hausdorff_distance without densify; E2 also checks topological equality.
limitations: Synthetic polygon coverage with shared zigzag edges and straight outer boundary, not real-world mixed geometry.
Serialization/reader implementations differ; timings are pipeline measurements, not inherent format speed.
GeoParquet-NONE and GeoParquet-ZSTD are separate codec configurations; gzip6 is a separate file-size experiment.
No cold-cache disk bandwidth, process memory, network, browser rendering or nationwide datasets measured.
MVT results intentionally involve clipping and quantization, and are not lossless full-dataset counterparts.
